brief: The time between the Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) resource finishing loading and the LCP element being rendered, in milliseconds
additional_context: One of the four LCP subparts, which add up to `browser.web_vital.lcp.value`. Named after `elementRenderDelay` in the web-vitals attribution build.
Measured as the LCP value minus the LCP resource's `responseEnd`. When the LCP element is text, it covers all time after TTFB.
